scope: Untouched starter workflow control, one public customer; not the builder-generated B agent.

speech.message: Hello, this is the digital assistant of Freya Bank. Am I speaking with Mr Reyes?
Thank you. Could you please provide your date of birth?
My date of birth is 14 March 1988.
Thank you. Now, could you please provide the last four digits of your phone number?
Thank you, that's verified. I'm calling about your Freya Bank account, do you have a minute?
Your credit card ending in 4821 is past due for 420 dollars. When can you pay this amount?
I can pay the full amount today.
Just to confirm, you will pay 420 dollars today, October 14th, 2026. Is that correct?
Thank you. Your payment promise has been recorded. Have a good day.
